name: Nové Sedlo (Czechia)
description: Divided per saltire by a yellow saltire into a red upper triangle, a white hoist triangle, a green fly triangle and a red lower triangle.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 12 May 1997 (decision No. 27) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
